_doc: Hand-authored verdicts for the 33 frame sites (never regenerated by build.py). Strength, route, bind, expiry and witness position are COMPUTED from the stored permits and the Atlas rows; nothing here asserts them. grade: 'narrative' = a sentence stating the operation (ceiling supports_A if the structural position is an Operations/Property/Equipment Description paragraph and the permit is unexpired); 'list' = a label, heading, table row or equipment list (supports_C). A term is a §3.1 term; ancillary units carry terms [] and say so. Follow-up (owner rulings 2026-11-19 P2-P4): P2 near-bound sites are re-scored; P3 a Permit Description line is a supports_C witness; P4 compounding_unspecified and extrusion_unspecified map to the capability terms compounding and extrusion.

quotes.quote: Open molding, mechanical, atomized, controlled spray-up application of non-vapor-suppressed resin and chopped fiberglass onto gelcoated molds.
